name: Skybreaker
tagline: An oath to seek and administer justice.

intro: Skybreakers are Surgebinders who wield Gravitation and Division. Where the Windrunner's second Surge binds things together, the Skybreaker's tears them apart — Division governs decay, burning and disintegration.

They bond highspren, and they organise themselves around law and codes. A Skybreaker chooses something external to follow and then follows it without flinching, which is a discipline the rest of Roshar tends to read as fanaticism.

quotes.text: The second is the Ideal of Justice, an oath to seek and administer justice.
quotes.source: Ki, explaining the Second Ideal of the Skybreakers — via The Coppermind, "Order of Skybreakers"

quotes.text: The Skybreakers are Surgebinders who use the Surges of Gravitation and Division, and they are associated with the smokestone polestone. They form a Nahel bond with highspren. They are widely thought of as fanatics in both Shadesmar and the Physical Realm.
The Skybreakers were the only Radiant order not to have abandoned their oaths on the Day of Recreance, and continued to operate in secret until the present day.

I watched you destroy yourself in the name of order, watched you obey your personal code when others would have fled or crumbled. Szeth-son-Neturo, I watched you keep your word with perfection. This is a thing lost to most people — it is the only genuine beauty in the world. I doubt I have ever found a man more worthy of the Skybreakers than you.
quotes.source: Nale to Szeth, Words of Radiance — via The Coppermind, "Order of Skybreakers"

gameplay.summary: The Skybreaker is planned around precision, destruction, and environmental chaos. Gravitation provides the Lashing kit shared with the Windrunner; Division fractures objects and heavily damages enemies. Only Gravitation is currently implemented.

abilities.name: Division Bubble
abilities.desc: Maintain a bubble while grounded or flying that fractures Chaos-enabled meshes. Impact velocity selects either an explosive impact or a slow-corroding fracture response. The input is undecided.

abilities.name: Division Touch
abilities.desc: Reach out while grounded to obliterate touched Chaos-enabled objects. Enemies take heavy damage instead of being physically obliterated. The input is undecided, and this attack cannot be used in the air.
